title: Narrow the formatting interface
summary: Replace a seven-parameter helper with small functions that take few, meaningful arguments.
instructions: format_line(line) formats an invoice line as 'description | qty x unit = total', with amounts as '12.34 EUR'.
line has description, qty, unit_cents and currency; total is qty x unit_cents.
Amounts always show two decimal places, for example 5 cents is '0.05 EUR'.
The starter code is correct but passes seven parameters to its helper; give every function a narrow interface.
constraints: Every function takes at most 2 parameters.
Every function is at most 12 lines long.

acceptance_criteria.description: The examples are formatted as expected.
All further lines are formatted as expected.
Every function takes at most 2 parameters.
Every function is at most 12 lines long.
